tasks.title: Setup Project Repository
tasks.description: Initialize the project repository with necessary configurations, version control, and directory structure.
tasks.details: Create a new repository on GitHub/GitLab. Set up a Python virtual environment with `python -m venv venv`. Install dependencies: `pandas==2.0.3`, `numpy==1.24.3`, `ccxt==4.1.0`, `tensorflow==2.12.0`, `scikit-learn==1.2.2`. Configure `.gitignore` to exclude virtual environment and sensitive files.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify repository setup by cloning it in a new environment and running basic Python scripts.

tasks.title: Integrate Delta Exchange API
tasks.description: Connect to Delta Exchange API for real-time trading and data fetching.
tasks.details: Use `ccxt` library to integrate Delta Exchange API. Implement authentication and basic order placement functions. Test with sandbox environment first. Handle rate limits and API errors gracefully.
tasks.testStrategy: Place test orders in sandbox mode and verify execution. Check for API response times and error handling.

tasks.title: Implement Multi-Timeframe Data Collection
tasks.description: Fetch and synchronize market data across 4H, 1H, 15M, and 5M timeframes.
tasks.details: Use `ccxt` to fetch OHLCV data for each timeframe. Implement a caching mechanism to store historical data. Ensure data synchronization across timeframes.
tasks.testStrategy: Validate data accuracy by comparing with manual API calls. Check synchronization logic with simulated data.

tasks.title: Develop Candle Formation Analysis
tasks.description: Analyze candle patterns (body, wicks, pressure) for trading signals.
tasks.details: Implement candle pattern detection using `pandas` and custom logic. Define rules for bullish/bearish candles. Store results in a structured format for further processing.
tasks.testStrategy: Test with historical data to verify pattern detection accuracy. Compare results with manual analysis.

tasks.title: Implement Momentum Train Detection
tasks.description: Detect momentum trends for entry/exit timing.
tasks.details: Use moving averages and RSI to identify momentum. Implement logic to detect momentum trains and reversals. Store signals for decision-making.
tasks.testStrategy: Backtest with historical data to validate momentum detection. Measure accuracy against known trends.

tasks.title: Build Trading Decision Engine
tasks.description: Translate confluence scores and momentum signals into trade decisions.
tasks.details: Implement logic for entry (75%+ confluence + momentum) and exit (trend reversal + candle formation). Include dynamic position sizing based on confidence.
tasks.testStrategy: Simulate trades with historical data. Validate decision accuracy and position sizing logic.

tasks.title: Integrate ML Model Decision Engine
tasks.description: Convert ML predictions (LSTM, Transformer) into trade decisions.
tasks.details: Load pre-trained ML models (`tensorflow`). Implement inference pipeline to generate predictions. Map predictions to trade signals (buy/sell).
tasks.testStrategy: Validate predictions against test datasets. Ensure trade signals align with model outputs.

tasks.title: Develop Ensemble Voting System
tasks.description: Combine predictions from multiple ML models for robust signals.
tasks.details: Implement weighted voting system for LSTM, Transformer, and CNN-LSTM models. Aggregate predictions into a single signal.
tasks.testStrategy: Test ensemble accuracy with historical data. Compare with individual model performance.

tasks.title: Implement Real-Time ML Inference
tasks.description: Run ML models in real-time for live trading decisions.
tasks.details: Optimize model inference for sub-second latency. Use `tensorflow-lite` for performance. Integrate with trading decision engine.
tasks.testStrategy: Measure inference latency and accuracy in live environment.

tasks.title: Build Analysis-Execution Bridge
tasks.description: Coordinate real-time data flow between analysis and execution engines.
tasks.details: Implement a messaging system (e.g., Redis) for data synchronization. Handle errors and retries. Ensure zero data loss.
tasks.testStrategy: Simulate high-frequency data flow. Verify synchronization and error handling.

tasks.title: Develop ML Position Management
tasks.description: Use ML models to predict position outcomes and manage exits.
tasks.details: Train models to predict position health. Implement logic to adjust exits based on predictions. Integrate with risk management.
tasks.testStrategy: Backtest with historical trades. Validate exit logic accuracy.

tasks.title: Implement Performance Monitoring
tasks.description: Track and optimize trading performance in real-time.
tasks.details: Log all trades and decisions. Calculate metrics like Sharpe ratio, win rate. Implement feedback loops for ML models.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify logging accuracy. Test feedback loops with simulated data.

tasks.title: Enhance Risk Management
tasks.description: Integrate adaptive stops and smart take profits with ML insights.
tasks.details: Implement dynamic stop-loss and take-profit logic. Use ML to adjust levels based on market conditions.
tasks.testStrategy: Simulate trades with varying market conditions. Validate risk management effectiveness.

tasks.title: Develop User Dashboard
tasks.description: Create a dashboard for real-time monitoring and reporting.
tasks.details: Use `Dash` or `Streamlit` for a web-based dashboard. Display P&L, open positions, and performance metrics. Ensure mobile responsiveness.
tasks.testStrategy: Test dashboard functionality and responsiveness. Verify data accuracy.

tasks.title: Deploy and Monitor System
tasks.description: Deploy the trading agent to production and set up monitoring.
tasks.details: Deploy on AWS/GCP with auto-scaling. Set up logging and alerts (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana). Monitor system health and performance.
tasks.testStrategy: Run in production with limited capital. Monitor for stability and performance.
